notes: Background: PulsarEdge builds a low-latency personalization layer for mobile SDKs (in-game and commerce).
Primary ask on call 2026-01-28: tail latency budget 50ms p99 for short chat-like completions (avg 6 tokens) at sustained 1k RPS per region.
Cost sensitivity: CFO target effective generation cost < $0.001/token; willing to use aggressive quantization if quality delta < 1.5% on A/B evals.
Topology: deploy VPC-connected Dedicated pools in us-east-1 + on-prem for EU region (data residency).
Interest in features: smart batching (latency-aware batching window), prefix/KV caching for repeat dialogs, quantized int8/int4 model variants for fallback.
POC plan agreed: 3-week POC -> week 1 functional + correctness; week 2 perf/latency; week 3 scale + SLO violations analysis.
SE notes (Ravi): run microbenchmark with sequence lengths [8,16,32], mix of cache hits 60%/miss 40%, measure cold vs warm KV cache impact.
AE note (Alicia): push SOW draft with 72-hour perf window and instrumentation hooks (tracing headers + token-level cost breakdown).
Security checklist: SSO via SAML in place, need SOC2 Type II report and KMS integration detail for on-prem key mirrors.
Customer quote from call: "If p99 spikes over 70ms during high concurrency we lose session-level conversions."
Evaluation metrics requested: p50/p95/p99, cold-start penalty, token/sec GPU, cost per 1k reqs with current batching config.
Legal asked for data residency addendum for EU on-prem deploy; procurement timeline uncertain (est. 6-8 weeks).
requirements_summary: Latency-sensitive conversational and personalization engine for mobile apps. Targets: p99 <50ms at 1k RPS with typical outputs 4-12 tokens. Cost goal: effective generation cost < $0.001/token. Needs batching/caching/quantization controls, routing policy for region + fallback to quantized variants, transparent billing + token-level telemetry.
